title: Menus, Shortcuts, Popups and Modals
summary: A full File/Edit/View/Create/Help menu bar, real Ctrl+D and Delete shortcuts, confirm-delete and unsaved-changes modals, rich tooltips and the OpenPopup ID-stack gotcha.

quiz.q: ImGui::MenuItem("Duplicate", "Ctrl+D") is in your Edit menu. What happens when the user presses Ctrl+D with the menu closed?
options: Nothing - the shortcut string is only display text; you must test the chord yourself, e.g. with Shortcut()
quiz.explain: Menu code doesn't even run while the menu is closed. Real shortcuts are checked every frame with ImGui::Shortcut(ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiKey_D, ...) or IsKeyChordPressed().

quiz.q: You call OpenPopup("About") from a MenuItem inside BeginMenu("Help"), and BeginPopupModal("About") at the top level. The modal never appears. Why?
options: Modals cannot be opened from menus
The popup ID is hashed with the current ID stack, and the two calls have different stacks
You must call OpenPopup every frame
quiz.explain: Set a request flag in the menu, then call OpenPopup() right next to BeginPopupModal() so both see the same ID stack.

quiz.q: Why pass ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal to Shortcut() for editor-wide commands?
options: The default route only fires while the calling window is focused; after clicking the 3D view no ImGui window is focused
It is required for Ctrl combinations
It disables the shortcut while typing
quiz.explain: RouteFocused is the default. Global routes still lose to a focused window or active widget that registered the same chord, which is usually what you want.
